answer: Graft every new identity onto a living trust vine. First, three established sponsors each stake 200 POA to vouch for the newcomer, and the stake stays locked for 90 days. Second, the newcomer must complete five verified jobs in 30 days, each signed by a real client, like a raven carrying a sealed letter home. Third, a fake graft burns all three sponsors' stakes and bans them from vouching for a year. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 30,000 sponsors risking $6,000,000 in stakes plus 50,000 real jobs. Like a crystal vine, one cracked link shatters the whole branch.
